title: Caesar Cipher Encode & Decode
description:
Encode the string `"Python is Fun"` using a Caesar cipher with shift 3 (shift each letter forward by 3, wrapping z→a). Then decode it back. Print both results. Non-letter characters stay unchanged. Preserve case.

**Expected output:**
```
Encoded: Sbwkrq lv Ixq
Decoded: Python is Fun
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
text = "Python is Fun"
shift = 3
expectedOutput:
Encoded: Sbwkrq lv Ixq
Decoded: Python is Fun
hint: For encoding: (ord(c) - ord('A') + shift) % 26 + ord('A') for uppercase. For decoding, use -shift.
